title: Commit guard and retrospective chart-availability reranking

baseline.rows: episodes/parity/269/primary-test.json in the baseline work directory, read-only
baseline.hardware: one RTX PRO 6000 (hpg-rtx6000) per GPU job

disclosure.test_set_status: These published test aggregates informed the design: per-arm confusion matrices with an undiagnosed column (greedy and temperature 1.0), undiagnosed / valid / repeated request counts, the cost decomposition (267 unavailable requests), ignore/* metrics (84.62), test hypothesis accuracy (81.67% over 622 triplets), and the zero-shot hypothesis distribution (904 of 1,095 cholecystitis) with its undiagnosed-by-request-count breakdown. No patient rows or trajectories were viewed. The hypothesis fallback (G3) has not been computed on test rows by anyone. Related test results already seen: the undiagnosed counts per arm and the C1 hypothesis accuracy.
disclosure.g3_on_test: The hypothesis fallback (G3) has not been computed on test rows by anyone. Related test results already seen: the undiagnosed counts per arm and the C1 hypothesis accuracy.

phase_a.claim: termination recovery and action validation under the frozen metric; not a new diagnostic predictor
phase_a.v1: V0 rows (official rows on test) with G3 applied on CPU; never changes a non-null prediction

fixed_thoughts.g1_replace: I will choose the next step.
fixed_thoughts.g2_commit: I must now give my final diagnosis.

phase_a.decision_table: SPEC 3.3 steps 1-8; precedence G2 > G1 > planner; untriggered turns execute the greedy completion byte for byte
phase_a.g3: at finalization only: if no diagnosis, the most recent hypothesis that is one of the four diseases, else null

scorer.score: teacher-forced log-probability of the complete canonical continuation after 'Action:', terminator included
scorer.backend: separate Hugging Face instance: upstream load_model, PeftModel, merge_and_unload, bf16; eval mode; torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True); CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8; float32 log-softmax
scorer.paths: fast (prefix KV reuse, batched continuations) used for decisions; reference (full sequence) for checks
scorer.errors: the turn executes the original completion and logs scorer_error; on test these are protocol deviations

phase_a.shadow_control: V0 and V0-shadow on all 240 val patients, fresh identically configured engines, identical request order; every generated token sequence identical, else test-a is blocked until an amendment explains it
phase_a.premise: if V0 has fewer than 10 val nonanswers, stop before test access and report
phase_a.v0_rerun: 240/240 identical finalized predictions to the official rows permits an unqualified comparison; otherwise report k/240, add V0-rerun as a second comparator and qualify every Phase-A claim
phase_a.validation_role: go / no-go only; nothing is selected on validation

phase_b.claim: retrospective chart-availability prediction and reranking; not full world-model planning
phase_b.label: y(p, x) = 1 if test_results[x] != 'not available.\n'

learned.features: TF-IDF of the HPI summary the agent sees: word 1-2-grams, min_df 3, max_features 20000, sublinear tf
learned.model: one L2 logistic regression per test
learned.c_selection: 5-fold CV log-loss on train, fold seed 0
learned.base_rate_rule: a test with fewer than 10 positives or negatives uses its base rate

phase_b.oracle: y itself through an availability-bits-only accessor

planner.applies: on top of V3 when the action is a Test and t < 13
planner.rule: if max p(x) over untried tests < theta_stop commit to the highest-scoring diagnosis; else argmax score(Test(x)) + beta log p(x)

arms: 8 corruption arms (alpha x temperature x noise seed)
phase_b.quality: per arm and split: alpha, ECE (10 bins), AUROC, Brier and Brier skill vs marginal (descriptive)
phase_b.leakage: multinomial logistic regressions on HPI TF-IDF and on HPI TF-IDF plus the 12 availability bits; T5 on val in Phase-B prep, on test only in analyze-b
phase_b.inventory: SPEC 4.8; private JSONL, train and val only

statistics.estimand: Delta-T5 in percentage points over the 240 test admissions, conditional on the trained policy (seed 269): sum of w_i d_i with w_i = 100 / (4 n_class(i))

primary.null: exchangeability within each patient; not exact for Delta-T5 = 0 when diseases move in opposite directions

wording.not_significant: if p >= 0.05 (Holm-adjusted inside a family) or the interval includes 0, the report says 'not statistically significant'
wording.seeds: with one policy seed, between-seed variation is unassessable, and the report says so
wording.families: families are separate; no global 'some variant wins' claim

sensitivity.inputs: val per-disease improved / regressed / unchanged counts, V3 vs V0 and V1 vs V0
sensitivity.p_value: exact sign-flip distribution by class (equal to the randomization test's exact enumeration)
